svg.text: Fighting wing, Spec 7e Draft 4 target structure: level 2
Proposed, not built: Spec 7e Draft 4 + Fable 3a/3b + Patrick's rulings of 14 Oct 2026.
B02 Perception (S0)
Does: Lead 0.4 s late and dead-reckoned: position round his
seen turn, bank extrapolated by his seen roll rate (D3);
#2's own state now; derives slant, closure from velocities
(D11), LOS rate, aspect, HCA, sweep, height v Lead, Lead's
circle, arc s, offset d, arc closure, Lead's G (S05b)
B03 Supervisor: phase and case (S3a)
Does: Phase weights (level, entry, turning, exit, sum 1)
from Lead's seen roll, blended 1.5 s; case label read once
per phase with ±50 ft dead band, side/case blended ≥6 s
B04 Supervisor: technique picker (S3b)
Does: Polls each technique's cue; one active at a time by
priority; 3 s no-restart timer; longest-run timer; writes
blend weight 0→1→0 (≥6 s path, ≥4.3 s height)
B05 Normal follower (S2)
Does: Writes the normal reference: path (circle concentric
with Lead's at B07's offset d, or swept line parallel to
Lead's track), caps 20° out / 12° in, Ke 0.026°/ft, height
target = stack − planned drop low inside (20 ft/kt past 5 kt
slow, cap −300 ft, D24), speed offset from B07's unmet
closure, intent 0, urgency 0
B06 Techniques T1-T8 (S3b)
Does: T1 pass clear (S3b), T2 back behind 3/9 line (S7), T3
lag pursuit from abeam (S6), T4 high yo-yo ending stacked
low (S7), T5 cut-across (S7), T6 exit vertical (S5), T7
S-turns (S5), T8 moving out from close formation (T30); each
cue, plan once, monitor, done; writes candidate reference
S26 and cue state S24 only
B07 Arc loop (S2)
Does: d = d_ss + w/ω + kc(w − c)/ω, w = (s − 650)/10 s, soft
closure limit 25→60 ft/s, d within ±250 ft, slewed 60 ft/s
(radius clipped ~20,000 ft); writes offset d (S30) and unmet
closure w − ω·d_cmd (S29b, clipped ±15 kt, D21)
B08 Reference blender (S1)
Does: From normal reference (S25), technique reference (S26)
and #2's position computes and blends by B04's weight (S23):
wanted course χ_w, path turn-rate ω_FF, height target h_T
and rate ḣ_T, speed offset Δv_ref, intent, urgency, cap
change
B09 Steering loop (S2)
Does: ω_cmd = ω_FF + 0.5 (χ_w − χ), crossover 0.52 rad/s
B10 Vertical loop (S3b)
Does: ΔG_v = 0.005 (h_T − h) + 0.02 (ḣ_T − ḣ), crossover
0.68 rad/s (D1 profile rate included)
B11 Power loop (S4)
Does: throttle = FF (drag of commanded G, climb, speed-brake
drag) + roll-in lead + 0.3 (V_L + Δv_ref − V) + min(intent,
−bleed request), clipped 0-1 (D21, D23); speed brake switch
under bleed intent ≤ −0.5 (out > 60 ft/s for 1 s, in < 20
ft/s, held ≥ 3 s, D8, D25)
B12 Guard (S3)
Does: One predictor on raw demands (S31, S32) over closing
part up to 10 s; silent at ≥600 ft; cubic taper x³ to 500
ft; least-change bounds on ω_cmd (S37) and ΔG_v (S38);
graded bleed request (S39); smooth cap opening 550→500 ft
(S40); side choice held 3 s (S41)
B13 Lift composer (S1)
Does: Composes bounded turn, 1 G hold and bounded vertical
within cap = min(stall warning, Lead G + 1.5 + S40 + S27f)
with 0.2 G soft knee; cap order: climb height demand gives
way first, then 1 G hold, turn last (D20); minG 0.5 G floor
with unload-roll-pull (never pushes to 0 or negative G);
hands drag of commanded G and climb (S44) to B11
B14 Shaper (S1)
Does: G onset 1 + 3u G/s by urgency u; roll ≤ 60°/s; unload,
roll, pull when wings are > 20° off wanted lift (fighting
wing only; close formation shape() untouched)
B15 #2 aircraft and engine (S0)
Does: T-6A point mass: thrust, drag, roll rate and build-up,
G build-up ≤ 4 G/s, stall warning, engine 0.25 s, idle spool
Numbers it adds (estimates unless ruled)
Adds: approach angle out (lag) 20° (ruling); approach angle
in (lead) 12° (ruling); approach cross-track slope Ke
0.026°/ft (k ≈ 1/420 ft out, 1/250 ft in) (tuning); course
gain Kχ 0.5 /s (tuning); range time constant τ_s = τ_r 10 s
(turn and level) (tuning); speed loop proportional gain Kv
0.3 /s (no integrator; set-point offset ±15 kt) (tuning);
drop-low-inside continuous term k_e 20 ft/kt past 5 kt slow,
capped −300 ft (tuning); phase thresholds and blend 10°
entry, 5° exit, 1.5 s phase blend, ≥6 s case/side blend
(tuning); guard taper and urgency cubic x³ on 600→500 ft;
onset 1 + 3u G/s; soft cap knee 0.2 G (tuning); exit
vertical and technique cue bands/dwells 12 ft per ft/s
(physics); D6 bands and dwells (tuning)
Numbers it removes
Removes: historySec; aimTurnSec; aimTurnCap.k;
aimTurnCap.plusDps; circleLookSec; circleLeastFt; routeFt;
lagFirst.deg; lagFirst.sec; lagFirst.easeSec; behind.downFt;
behind.clearFt; sweptLookSec; quickFixFt; quickFixFtps;
quickFixHeightFt; quickReleaseFt; quickReleaseFtps;
quickSec; lowFt; lowStartKt; lowEndKt; yoyo.slowKt;
yoyo.powerBackKt; yoyo.excessFtps; guard.engageFt;
guard.releaseFt; guard.releaseSec; guard.missSlantFt;
guard.torquePct; guard.filterHoldSec; guard.engage.marginFt;
guard.engage.releaseSec; guard.lagSec
